title: Debug: Req/Ack Handshake Receiver
constraints: Intended behavior: a **4-phase** receiver. IDLE: an edge sampling `req = 1` captures `data_in` into `data_out`, raises `ack` and pulses `strobe` for one cycle.
`ack` stays high until an edge samples `req = 0`. Then `ack` falls and the receiver returns to IDLE. Each req pulse delivers exactly one word, however long it lasts.
Registered outputs, synchronous reset (`ack = 0`, `data_out = 0`, `strobe = 0`). The starter has **2 bugs**.
hints: Hold `req` high for 5 cycles. How many strobes do you get?
Which value of `data_in` ends up in `data_out`: the one present when req rose, or the one when it fell?
Draw the four phases: req↑, ack↑, req↓, ack↓.

examples.title: one word
examples.input: req high for 4 cycles with data 0x42
examples.expected: one strobe, data_out = 0x42, ack high until req falls

examples.title: capture timing
examples.input: data_in changes while req is high
examples.expected: data_out keeps the value from the rising edge
